_comment: tools/harness/hitch_check.py limits (ms of wall time per frame, harness fixed 1/60 s step, 1600x900, RTX 3070 Ti class). Set 2026-10-21 from the hitch pass's measurements with headroom for GPU noise from other work on the machine. Lookup: default, then scenarios.<S>.all, then rates.<rate>, then scenarios.<S>.<rate>. first_frame_max_ms replaces max_ms for the step holding the first frame after load (A/B 1x); boot_max_ms is launch to first frame (the log's 'boot: Starting').
